description: Start a dev server and tee its logs into the buffer. Three ways to specify it: (1) `project` — a saved registry project (resolves cmd/cwd); (2) explicit `cmd`+`cwd`; (3) neither — `cwd` defaults to the server's directory and `cmd` is auto-detected from package.json. Explicit cmd/cwd override the project's. Stop it with dev_stop; check it with dev_status.

cmd.description: Full dev command. If omitted, auto-detected from package.json.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the server's cwd.

project.description: Name of a saved project (see project_list).

name: dev_start
